response.sql: SELECT AVG(Total) FROM Invoice WHERE Total > 3.98

assumptions.assumption: "Selected using a total threshold of 3.98" means invoices whose Total is strictly greater than 3.98 (the direction and inclusivity of the threshold are not stated in the request).
AVG ignores NULL totals and returns NULL when no invoices qualify, matching the requested missing result; the value is left unrounded.

alternatives.interpretation: Invoices with Total greater than or equal to 3.98 (inclusive threshold).
alternatives.sql: SELECT AVG(Total) FROM Invoice WHERE Total >= 3.98

alternatives.interpretation: Invoices with Total less than or equal to 3.98 (threshold as an upper bound).
